assumptions.A_time: state.time is 0 until the timing line at plan metre 100 and counts race seconds from there
assumptions.B_eventDistance: state.eventDistance is 0 until the timing line and counts from it; remainingEnd is the plan length minus the line (10610 m)
assumptions.C_rpc: getEvent/getEventSubgroup shapes are guesses at the Zwift API objects Sauce returns
assumptions.D_physics: the rider holds each interval's plan power and speed exactly; no response lag
assumptions.E_rivals: 6 made-up riders released -20/-10/-5/5/10/25 s from the home rider at 0.985/1.012/0.995/1.02/0.97/1 x the plan's speed; nearby every 2 s
